articles.summary: Here we go again... Discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board by Sydney Von Arx, Cormac Slade Byrd, Spencer Kitts, and Thomas Larsen describes the latest accidental cyberattack by models being trained by OpenAI. This time it was agents engaged in some sort of web research benchmark, so they had (supposedly) controlled access to the Web. articles.title: How to protect yourself from workslop
articles.summary: “Workslop” is when your colleagues or bosses communicate with you by pasting big chunks of AI-generated text.
